steps.crossing: Sometimes one hand crosses over the other to reach notes beyond it. Here the left hand plays its chord, the right hand plays the next one up, and the left hand lifts over the right to play the highest. Those notes are written on the other staff, marked L.H. Lift the crossing hand high enough to pass, and let the pedal hold the sound.
steps.handOverHand: {c} major, hand over hand: left, right, the left over the top, and home.
steps.rightOver: Now the other way: the right hand crosses over the left to play the lowest notes, marked R.H.
